e: Borrowed from Sanskrit यज्ञ (yajñá). Doublet of Yasna.
q: The visit to Pushkar is, however, a little more than the obligatory obeisance done at the site where Brahma carelessly dropped a lotus blossom as he was wondering where to perform a yagnya.
